item.title: Data Shows Gulf Between 'MAGA,' 'MAHA,' and 'America First' Voters Over Iran, But Most Agree Israel Has 'Too Much Influence.'
item.description: Polling by the Democracy Institute has revealed where the divisions are among likely Republican voters regarding the ongoing U.S.-Israeli war on Iran. Among self-identified "MAGA" Republicans, President Trump's intervention in Iran is more popular than not, with 54 percent viewing the conflict as a "security necessity," while 43 percent see it as a "costly mistake."

item.title: TSA Agents Receive Back Pay After Trump Intervenes.
item.description: Most Transportation Security Administration (TSA) employees affected by the Senate Democrats' shutdown of the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) received at least two paychecks covering back pay for the two prior pay periods on Monday.

item.title: This European NATO Member is Denying the U.S. Access to Its Airspace for Iran Operations.
item.description: Spain's Defense Minister has announced that the country will no longer allow U.S. military planes to traverse its airspace to conduct operations against the Islamic Republic of Iran. The Spanish socialist government made the announcement on Monday and stressed that the country has made its opposition to the U.S. military actions in the Middle East clear from the beginning.

item.title: Bannon: Netanyahu’s Son in Miami, Arab Princes in London Should be Frontlines of Kharg Island Invasion.
item.description: Stephen K. Bannon, host of the WarRoom show and former White House Chief Strategist during President Donald J. Trump's first administration, has called for the drafting of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's son and various Arab princes in the event of an amphibious invasion of Iran's Kharg Island.

item.title: BLM Organizer Ordered to Forfeit Over $224,000 for COVID Fraud Scheme, But Avoids ANY Jail Time.
item.description: Boston-based Black Lives Matter (BLM) activist Monica Cannon-Grant has been ordered to forfeit $224,063 by a federal judge to cover taxpayer dollars she stole through diverting donations from her nonprofit, collecting fraudulent pandemic unemployment benefits, and pocketing rental assistance. The forfeiture ruling, issued last week, is in addition to the $106,000 restitution payment ordered when Cannon-Grant was sentenced this past January.

item.title: GOP Senator Introduces Bill to Debank Illegal Migrants.
item.description: Senator Tom Cotton, representing Arkansas, has put forth the Know Your American Customer Act, a legislative proposal aimed at barring illegal migrants from participating in the American banking system.

item.title: Hezbollah Orchestrated Michigan Synagogue Attack, FBI Confirms.
item.description: The man who targeted the largest Jewish Reform synagogue in Michigan earlier this month was directed by the Iranian-backed Lebanese terror group Hezbollah, according to the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI).

item.title: Trump Admin Resumes Asylum Processing After 5-Month Pause.
item.description: The Trump administration has moved to lift the Department of Homeland Security's (DHS) hold on reviewing asylum applications, though the department stresses that restrictions continue to remain in place for around 40 countries of particular national security concern.

item.title: BREAKING: Palm Beach Airport Renamed for Trump.
item.description: Florida Governor Ron DeSantis has approved House Bill 919, which will rename Palm Beach International Airport to President Donald J. Trump International Airport. The approval was given on March 30, 2026.

item.title: Newsom and the California Democrats Are Killing Los Angeles.
item.description: Los Angeles County, California, has seen a significant population decline, with roughly 54,000 residents leaving between July 2024 and July 2025, according to newly released U.S. Census Bureau data. Once home to over 10 million people in 2020, the county's population has now dropped below 9.7 million.

item.title: Trump Admin Charges Nine in $1.1 Million Massachusetts Benefit Fraud Scheme.
item.description: A coordinated federal crackdown in Massachusetts has resulted in charges against nine individuals for social welfare benefit fraud schemes exploiting stolen identities. The schemes targeted taxpayer-funded programs such as the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), MassHealth, and Social Security benefits. The investigation, ongoing since December 2025, uncovered nearly $9 million in fraudulent activity.
